ValidationRule.description: V-OUT-05: Blocks stage advancement past ASA In Progress when Finance has not been cleared. Finance Cleared must be set to Cleared before the case can move to RO Review or beyond.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Outgoing_Exchange', OR( ISPICKVAL(Status, 'RO Review'), ISPICKVAL(Status, 'Transcript Check'), ISPICKVAL(Status, 'Student Credit Check'), ISPICKVAL(Status, 'Closed') ), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Finance_Cleared__c, 'Cleared')) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Finance must be cleared before case can progress past ASA In Progress.
